answer_text:
The **G-Wagon** (officially known as the **Mercedes-Benz G-Class**) is a **four-wheel drive luxury SUV**. Here's a breakdown of what makes it special:

### What It Is
The Mercedes-Benz G-Class, colloquially known as the G-Wagon or G-Wagen (as an abbreviation of **Geländewagen**), is a four-wheel drive luxury SUV sold by Mercedes-Benz.

### History
Developed initially for military use, the G-Class was first introduced to the civilian market in **1979** and was officially offered in the U.S. starting with the 2002 model year.

### Design
The G-Class is characterized by its **boxy styling** and **body-on-frame construction**. Over the decades, it has earned a reputation for its **off-road capabilities**, iconic boxy design, and impeccable build quality.

### Off-Road Capability
It uses **three fully locking differentials**, making it one of the few passenger vehicles to have such a feature.

### Luxury & Performance
Despite its high price, the G-Class has maintained a loyal following among enthusiasts who appreciate its timeless aesthetic and off-road prowess. The SUV has seen various iterations over the years, including the addition of extremely powerful **AMG performance-tuned models**.

### Longevity
Despite the introduction of an intended replacement, the G-Class is still in production and is one of the **longest-produced vehicles** in Daimler's history, with a span of 46 years.

In short, the G-Wagon is a rugged, boxy, **luxury off-road SUV** made by Mercedes-Benz that has become a cultural status symbol while still being a serious off-road machine.
